apps.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
apps.goal: A two-player Tic-Tac-Toe game with a 3x3 grid. Players take turns placing X and O marks. The first to get 3 in a row wins. Includes win detection, draw detection, and a reset button.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.goal: A basic four-function calculator supporting addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Includes number buttons, operator buttons, clear, sign toggle, percentage, and an equals button to compute results.

apps.name: Todo List
apps.goal: A task management app where users can add, complete, and delete tasks. Tasks are saved to localStorage. Shows remaining item count and supports check/uncheck of completed items.

apps.name: Timer
apps.goal: A countdown timer with preset durations (5, 10, 15, 30 minutes). Features start/pause/resume controls, a reset button, and an alert when time runs out.

apps.name: Weather Widget
apps.goal: A weather display app that shows temperature, humidity, and wind speed for a searched city. Includes preset cities (London, Paris, Tokyo, New York, Sydney, Moscow) with simulated weather data.

apps.name: Note Pad
apps.goal: A note-taking app with multiple notes, auto-save to localStorage, add/delete notes, and a text editor. Users can create, edit, and organize multiple notes.

apps.name: Stopwatch
apps.goal: A stopwatch with start/pause, lap time tracking, and reset functionality. Shows elapsed time in minutes:seconds.tenths format and lists all lap times.

apps.name: Color Picker
apps.goal: An RGB color picker with three sliders (red, green, blue) showing a live preview. Displays hex value, copy-to-clipboard, and saves favorite colors to localStorage.

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.goal: A unit converter supporting length, mass, temperature, speed, and volume conversions. Features category switching, swap units button, and live conversion as you type.

apps.name: Countdown
apps.goal: A date countdown app showing days, hours, minutes, and seconds until a target date. Includes preset events (Christmas, New Year), custom date picker, and a celebration message.

apps.name: Claims Audit
apps.goal: Tests VACA's stated claims (data/soul.json) against the live backend: quick or full probe run, per-claim PASS/FAIL + scores, and an improvement report. Mirrors scripts/audit-claims.py in the browser.
